name: Catan Card Game

overview.description: Catan Card Game is a commercial two-player card adaptation of Catan focused on building settlements, roads, and resources through cards.

history.origins: Designed by Klaus Teuber and published by Kosmos, the Catan Card Game adapts the Settlers of Catan resource-building system into a two-player card format.
timeline: Documented card-play form: Catan Card Game is described as a distinct game with its own rules.

setup.players: 2 players use the table arrangement described for Catan Card Game.
setup.equipment: Dedicated Catan Card Game deck, score area, and enough table space for play.
setup.dealing: Each player sets up a small principality with settlement, road, and resource cards, then draws from development decks.

rules.objective: Build the stronger principality and reach the required victory point total first.
rules.gameplay: Players generate resources, build roads and settlements, play development cards, and improve their principality while managing event effects.
keyRules: Settlements and city improvements score points.
First to the victory point target wins.
